applicant_utility.summary: This is the top single-award version of UTS's international undergraduate funding: the value is stated simply as 'UTS Tuition Fees' for the standard duration of the course, with no dollar cap published. It is awarded to the highest ranked applicant, which means you are competing for one place on a combination of your admission qualification and your answers in the scholarship application itself - so the written responses in that form carry real weight, not just your transcript. The window is short and fixed: Thursday 1 October to Monday 2 November 2026 at 11.55pm AEST, and you must also have met UTS admission criteria for your chosen program by that same date. Two eligibility details catch people out: your Year 12 (or comparable) qualification must have been completed within three years of commencing, and you cannot be studying a UTS online or distance-mode degree, even though some remote learning inside an on-campus degree is fine.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent international school leavers with an 85%+ average in a UTS-recognised Year 12 qualification, completed within the last three years, who are starting a full-time on-campus bachelor degree at UTS Sydney.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your Year 12 or comparable qualification was completed within three years of your intended UTS commencement
Check your overall average is 85% where the pass mark is 50%, or the recognised equivalent, in that qualification
Verify you are admitted (or will meet admission criteria by 2 November 2026) on the basis of that same school qualification
Confirm your program is delivered on campus in Sydney and is not an online or distance-mode degree
Prepare your answers to the scholarship application questions around UTS's core values - excellence, innovation, entrepreneurship and social justice
Submit the UTS online Scholarships Application form before 11.55pm AEST on Monday 2 November 2026, and note that this is AEST, not your local time
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 11.55pm AEST cut-off on 2 November 2026, especially if your timezone puts that earlier in your day
Not having met UTS admission criteria for the chosen program by the scholarship closing date
Letting more than three years pass between finishing Year 12 and commencing at UTS
Treating the written responses in the scholarship application as an afterthought when they are half the ranking
Holding another UTS International Grant or Scholarship without an approved exception in the Conditions of Award
Applying for an online or distance-mode degree, which is excluded
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: All living costs, accommodation, Overseas Student Health Cover, flights and visa costs. The scholarship covers UTS tuition fees only.
